description: Before planning motion, load playbook/motion-design (timing, easing, choreography, depth, sound). Send one typed edit operation, a list of 1 to 20 operations (one batch, one Undo in Premiere), or compatibility English text, to your approved Premiere sequence. When the connection reports alwaysAllow true the edit runs on arrival; otherwise it waits for a press in the panel. Several requests may queue. The whole Adobe surface is typed (docs/premiere/OPERATIONS.md has one row per kind with the Adobe call behind it). Cutting kinds take picture (V) or sound (A) clip keys. Kinds: duplicate, save, bin, import, organize, insert, audio, overwrite (a library item laid over the timeline at a point, replacing what is under it), trim, head, split, remove, enable, rename, move, clipmarks, marker, markeredit, markermove, markerremove, effect, effectat, effectremove, audioeffect, keyframe, unkeyframe, animate, transition, untransition, transcribe, importtranscript, scenecut, select, track, export, encode, batch, aaf, fcpxml, otio, fetch (one of your Switch videos or images by id lands next to the project and, with at plus video and audio tracks, on the timeline; no file picker), caption (text on screen above a clip as a motion graphics template), sourcemarks, subclip, label, interpret, lut, scaletoframe, relink, proxy, offline, refresh, renamemedia, renamebin, removeitem, smartbin, metadata, newsequence, subsequence, deletesequence, opensequence, closesequence, sequencemarks, zeropoint, settings, playhead, workarea, saveas, openproject, closeproject, importsequences, importae, newproject, preference, ingest, scratch, monitor, clone (a copy of a clip at an offset on another track), mogrt (a template from a Creative Cloud library), override, encodefile, launchencoder, xmp, purgecache, growing, metadatafield, panelmetadata, property, mediastart, inspect (a read: markers, effects, transitions, settings, metadata, workarea, playhead, app, keyframes, transcript, interpretation, media, clip, sequences, selection, panel, columns, property, c2pa, masks, language, production, tracks, monitor, colour, find, bin, captions, nearest; the answer comes back as the receipt). Files are named next to the project, never as paths. The transcribe receipt lists the spoken lines with their seconds. Tick strings must align to sequence frames; tracks are zero based. Imports require the local file picker. Supply the revision and target from a timeline read. Use the same requestId for retries. Queued does not mean edited.
